# Git Commit Instructions

All commit messages, code comments, and documentation must be written in English.

- Use clear, concise English for all commit messages.
- Do not use Chinese or other languages in commit messages or documentation.
- Follow the project's English language and style guidelines.
- Example commit message:
  - "Fix resource duplication issue in release build"
  - "Enable minify for release variant"

For more details, refer to the project instructions in `docs/docs/instructions/project.instructions.md`.
